helpIntro: IU Bloomington uses a 4.0 scale. Enter IU credit hours and final grades; A+ and A are 4.0, and F counts as 0.0 with its credit hours included.
helpNote: For IU Bloomington undergraduate institutional GPA planning. Non-IU transfer grades, P/S, I, W and other non-GPA marks are excluded. Repeat Impact is only an estimate for an approved X replacement; Fresh Start and program-specific rules require record review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 grade points and a 3-credit B- earns 8.1. Together, 20.1 ÷ 6 = 3.350.

gradeExplanations.A+: A+ = 4.0; IU caps the scale at 4.0.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7, the lowest passing letter grade.
gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.0; its GPA credit hours still count.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is excluded until replaced by a final grade; normally becomes F after the allowed period if unresolved.
gradeExplanations.R: Deferred grade is excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.NC: Non-credit/audit notation is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: No Report is temporary and excluded until a grade is submitted.
gradeExplanations.NY: Special-program enrollment notation is excluded until credit/grade is recorded.
gradeExplanations.X: X marks a prior undergraduate attempt removed from GPA under an approved grade replacement.
gradeExplanations.FX: Legacy failure-replaced notation is excluded from GPA calculations.

specialTypes.name: Indiana University course
specialTypes.note: Use the final IU transcript grade. IU coursework across campuses can contribute to the university GPA, subject to record rules.

specialTypes.name: Non-IU transfer course
specialTypes.note: Accepted non-IU transfer credit may count toward a degree but its grade does not enter the IU GPA.

specialTypes.name: Credit by examination / assessed prior learning
specialTypes.note: Credit earned by examination or assessment is not GPA-bearing; an A used to denote superior examination performance is not included in GPA.

specialTypes.name: Fresh Start / academic renewal record
specialTypes.note: Fresh Start can remove pre-return grades from GPA for eligible returning Bloomington undergraduates; use your recalculated official baseline rather than guessing course-by-course.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is an estimate only. Use it only if your school confirms X eligibility and the replacement is approved; Bloomington limits the option to three courses or 10 credits, whichever is less.
